ops.text: Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance provision even though Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and collects and stores visitor data, so we have added our standard coverage (CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation) with certificates on request. We have dropped the one-year post-termination tail to keep the insertion to our standard requirements.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance provision as new General Provisions subsection (j)

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2M.
Cyber and privacy insurance of USD 5M for vendors processing Customer Data.
Workers' compensation as required by law.
